digest.component_or_area: plan-writing guide and LLM coaching moves documentation
propositions: The plan-writing guide lacks documentation of the 15 registered coaching moves from coach_moves.py, leaving coached authors unable to look up techniques they are advised to use.

The top five coaching moves by field frequency (specification-by-example, plan-the-verification, riskiest-assumption-test, state-attestation-evidence, propagate-to-children) must be documented in the guide with technique descriptions and before/after examples.
The [operator-attested] tag used in state-attestation-evidence coaching must be documented in the guide.
Move names in the guide must exactly match the MOVE_REGISTRY spellings in coach_moves.py and be verified by unit tests.

A new 'Responding to coaching moves' section shall be added to writing-a-passing-plan.md with top-five moves in frequency order, a one-line index of the remaining ten moves, and a cross-link from the advisory section.
